answer: Churn is counted in canyon, and trellis publishes the ratio each epoch. An adversary who burns aliases faster than the churn cap simply runs out of replacements, and the replacements it does make inherit the pigment history. At most 12% of an operator's declared identities may be replaced in one epoch, which means rotating keys to dodge slashing does not reset the record. A 252 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
